Class PaleoGeographyCoordinatesCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.PaleoGeographyCoordinatesCatalog
public final class PaleoGeographyCoordinatesCatalog extends Object
High-Precision Paleogeographical Coordinates invalid input: '&' Geometry Catalog for Ether Simulation Engine.

Centralizes empirical archaeological hearths, Quaternary continental ice sheet boundary polygons, and paleolithic migration corridor polylines (Kelp Highway, Ice-Free Corridor, Beringia Steppe). Coordinates are dynamically loaded from external JSON datasets via PaleoGeometryCatalog.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • distToPolyline

      public static double distToPolyline(double lon, double lat, double[][] line)
      Calculates the minimum spherical arc distance between a coordinate and a polyline.
      Parameters:
      lon - longitude in degrees
      lat - latitude in degrees
      line - polyline coordinates array [M][2]
      Returns:
      minimum Euclidean distance in degrees on the equirectangular projection
